tools.description:
🎵 EXPRESS YOURSELF VOCALLY! Pure local-first voice synthesis with zero cloud dependencies.

🌐 LOCAL-FIRST ARCHITECTURE: Kokoro TTS Only
Audio plays directly in background. Always uses female English voice (bf_isabella).

📝 TEXT PREPROCESSING REQUIREMENTS:
Please preprocess text before sending to ensure optimal synthesis:

1. LANGUAGE & TRANSLATION:
   - Always provide English text only
   - Translate non-English text to natural, conversational English

2. TTS OPTIMIZATION (CRITICAL):
   - Expand abbreviations: "Dr." → "Doctor", "Mr." → "Mister", "etc." → "etcetera"
   - Convert numbers to words: "123" → "one hundred twenty-three", "2024" → "twenty twenty-four"
   - Spell out currency: "$50" → "fifty dollars", "€25" → "twenty-five euros"
   - Expand dates: "Jan 1st" → "January first", "12/25" → "December twenty-fifth"
   - Convert times: "3:30 PM" → "three thirty PM", "14:00" → "two PM"
   - Spell out symbols: "&" → "and", "%" → "percent", "@" → "at"
   - Handle acronyms: "NASA" → "N.A.S.A." (with dots for proper pronunciation)

3. SPEECH FLOW:
   - Use natural punctuation (commas, periods) for speech pauses
   - Break long sentences into shorter, speakable segments
   - Ensure text flows naturally when spoken aloud

Example: "Dr. Smith earned $1,000 on Jan 1st @ 3:30 PM (approx. 50%)"
→ "Doctor Smith earned one thousand dollars on January first at three thirty PM, approximately fifty percent"

text.description: English text to speak aloud. Please preprocess according to the guidelines above for optimal synthesis quality.
